verdict.rationale: stagewise lets developers use what they already pay for by bringing existing provider API keys per provider, and the README says subscriptions can be connected with a single API key to unlock all of that provider's models. A stagewise Account sign-in also provides managed inference on the free Hobby and paid plans. However, nothing shows signing in with a consumer subscription plan (e.g. a Claude or ChatGPT plan) instead of an API key, and community reports describe a broken sign-in and sign-up flow. Missing for 10: documented sign-in/OAuth with an existing provider subscription plan, plan-limit/usage documentation, and independent confirmation that subscription-based access works.
